name: DTB Scene Transition
description: Full-screen scene transition (zero-step graphic, played once): the four red F of the Turnerkreuz fly in from the screen corners, turning and growing, while the background fades to white; they hold as the complete Turnerkreuz (80% of the screen height) for a configurable time, then fly back out and the background fades to transparent. Play runs the whole sequence once and the graphic animates out by itself; Stop is optional and aborts the sequence early.

holdSeconds.title: Opaque duration in seconds (fully white, Turnerkreuz complete)

heightPercent.title: Turnerkreuz height in % of screen height

rotationDegrees.title: Rotation of each F during fly-in/out in degrees (0 = none, negative = other direction)

startSizePercent.title: Size of the F's at the screen corners in % (they grow past 100% briefly and settle at 100%)
